entries.text: Start small, then revise from evidence
entries.narration: Try the template on one small recurring task this week. Write the trigger in one sentence, attach only the source material that changes a decision, name one check a reviewer can actually perform, and record one uncertainty that the Agent must not smooth over. If that version helps a second real run, keep it. If it fails, revise the field that failed instead of adding unrelated instructions everywhere.
